posts.title: AI Coding Isn't Satisfying
posts.description: There's an AI-written PR open in my editor, waiting for a review for 4 days. It's only 3k lines. I have struggled reviewing it. Instead, I seem to prefer playing Manor Lords or writing a blog post like this to vent. This is unprecedented. There were better times when I managed to write and review larger PRs in one sitting. posts.title: An abstraction for handling TLS in self-hosted applications
posts.description: We recently made Hyvor Blogs self-hostable . While working on it, I came up with an opinionated abstraction - a way to reason about TLS handling in self-hosted applications. TLS Mode The core principle is to introduce a TLS_MODE configuration that supports the following values: auto : the application manages TLS external : a reverse proxy terminates TLS manual : the user provides the certificates

posts.title: With --time-limit, does Symfony kill messenger consumers while a message is being handled?
posts.description: I was worried about that, and it appears Symfony does not kill messenger consumers while a message is being handled, only after the message is handled . This is true for all --limit , --memory-limit , --time-limit options.
